_doc: The package identity (docs/ops/IDENTITY.md). Read by build.rs (the exe's <msix> element), scripts/release.mjs (the signed .msix) and identity.rs (registration). `version` is the identity version, NOT the app's: raise it when the manifest or the logos change, so the updated hook registers the new package (§3.4). `publisher` must equal the Artifact Signing subject exactly, or the package family (so the app ID, so every pin) changes; release-check holds it.
